gates.name: Test (build.yml, .NET job)
Run the sample in both roles (build.yml)
Assert no framework project references a workload (build.yml)
Typecheck (build.yml, game-service job)
Start the workload and the edge, the documented way (build.yml)
gates.command: see build.yml step 'Start the workload and the edge, the documented way'

gates.name: Run the replay against the workload (build.yml)
gates.command: cd workloads/game-service && npx vitest run tests/replay.test.ts

gates.name: Run the replay against the edge (build.yml)
gates.command: cd workloads/game-service && GAME_EDGE_DLL=<path> npx vitest run tests/replay-edge.test.ts

gates.name: Migrate the schema to head, the documented way (build.yml)
Start the workload against the durable store, the documented way (build.yml)
gates.command: cd workloads/game-service && GAME_SERVICE_PORT=8081 GAME_SERVICE_STORAGE=durable GAME_SERVICE_DB_CONNECTION_STRING=postgresql://game_service:game_service@127.0.0.1:5432/game_service GAME_SERVICE_DB_SCHEMA=ci_documented_durable_start npm start

gates.name: Run the one-instance contention proof (build.yml)
gates.command: cd workloads/game-service && npx vitest run tests/contention-one-instance.test.ts

gates.name: Run the two-instance contention proof (build.yml)
gates.command: cd workloads/game-service && npx vitest run tests/contention-two-instances.test.ts

gates.name: Run the durable replay (build.yml)
gates.command: cd workloads/game-service && npx vitest run tests/durable-replay.test.ts

gates.name: Run the port-conformance suite (build.yml)
gates.command: cd workloads/game-service && npx vitest run tests/conformance.test.ts

gates.name: Test (build.yml, game-service job, full npm test)
Validate Markdown links, terminology, and generated files (docs-ci.yml)
Validate design/30-slices.md's Status markers (docs-ci.yml)
Build and verify the status-page site (docs-ci.yml verify job)
gates.command: npm --prefix site ci && npm --prefix site run check

gates.name: Build and verify the status-page site (docs-deploy.yml)
gates.command: npm --prefix site ci && npm --prefix site run check

gates.name: PowerShell parse-check (all *.ps1)
Invoke-Pester -Path tools
tools/Test-Companion.ps1 (core/companion split)
tools/Test-DesignState.ps1 (design state vs. tree)
